verdict.rationale: Identity resolution is a core, applicable axis for a product-analytics platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents identifying users across devices or merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile. The only nearby evidence is profile export (Engage API) and Query API profile and activity-stream retrieval, which are adjacent features and do not show identity merging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify users across devices and merge anonymous pre-signup activity into their identified profile
